meta.title: SLATE grocery research: chains, staple prices and shelf life
meta.method: Prices were read programmatically on 2026-10-01 from each chain's own public storefront or catalogue endpoint where one answered: Price Rite, The Fresh Grocer, Smart & Final, SuperValu and Save-On-Foods through their Wynshop storefrontgateway preview search; Chedraui through its VTEX catalog search; Giant Tiger through its Shopify products.json. Those rows have confirmed:true. Tesco, Sainsbury's and most other chains blocked automated reads (HTTP 403 or a bot check), so GB prices come from Trolley.co.uk, a third-party tracker, and are confirmed:false. Where a product was on promotion the regular price is recorded and the promotional price is in the note.

fieldNotes.sizeQty: Converted to g, ml or ct (1 oz = 28.3495 g, 1 US fl oz = 29.5735 ml, 1 lb = 453.592 g, 1 US gal = 3785.41 ml), rounded to the nearest unit.
fieldNotes.pricedBy: 'each' = price for the stated pack; 'weight' = price per the stated weight (per lb or per kg) for loose or variable-weight items.
fieldNotes.taxIncluded: true for GB, IE and MX, where shelf prices include tax. false for US and CA: food for home consumption is generally exempt from US state and local sales tax and zero-rated for Canadian GST/HST, while alcohol, soft drinks and some snacks and prepared foods are taxed at the register. Container deposits (CT, NY, California CRV, BC) are also extra. No tax rates are asserted in this file.
fieldNotes.url: For the Wynshop chains the url is the chain's own search page for the product and sourceId is the SKU/UPC from the API; for Chedraui and Giant Tiger it is the product page; for GB it is the Trolley.co.uk product page.
fieldNotes.storage: Storage was assigned by the researcher from the product type (fridge for fresh dairy and meat, freezer for frozen, pantry for shelf-stable); null where the source did not say chilled or frozen.

meta.shelfLifeNotes: From the USDA FSIS FoodKeeper dataset (FoodKeeper-Data.xls, data version 128, the version that file flags as current), obtained from a GitHub mirror (https://github.com/BrandonChenze/FoodKeeperResearch/blob/main/datasets/FoodKeeper-Data.xls) because foodsafety.gov and fsis.usda.gov refused automated reads. A newer FoodKeeper release may exist. Fields: pantry, fridge and freezer are FoodKeeper's plain columns; the *FromPurchase fields are its DOP (date of purchase) columns; *AfterOpening and fridgeAfterThawing are as named. minDays and maxDays are converted with Days=1, Weeks=7, Months=30, Years=365. Non-numeric values ('Indefinitely', 'When Ripe', 'Not Recommended', 'Package use-by date') are kept in unit and note with null days. FSA (UK) and safefood (IE) guidance was not consulted.
gaps: No product prices for Stop & Shop, Trader Joe's, Aldi (US, UK, IE), Lidl, Walmart, Target, Tesco Ireland, Dunnes, No Frills, FreshCo/Voilà, Bodega Aurrera, Walmart México or Soriana: their sites refused automated reads.
New Haven: no chain with an open price feed operates inside the city; Price Rite prices are from its Hamden store on the New Haven line.
GB prices come from a third-party tracker (confirmed:false), not from tesco.com or sainsburys.co.uk.
The Giant Tiger catalogue is national with regional duplicates; the Toronto price was not isolated.
SuperValu store 5550 (the site default) was not tied to a branch; SuperValu prices are set per store.
Chedraui prices are the site default seller, not a specific Mexico City branch.

Missing individual staples: Smart & Final plain gallon milk; The Fresh Grocer gallon milk and beer; Giant Tiger canned tuna, canned beans and alcohol; GB beer; Sainsbury's eggs. Tesco's egg count is taken from the product URL.
Beer and wine shelf life: not in FoodKeeper; left null.
Delivery fees for several chains are web-search summaries (confirmed:false) or not found (null).
